# Optimism Bridge

> Optimism Bridge moves ETH and tokens from Ethereum to Optimism, also called OP Mainnet. Compare token routes and estimate deposit gas fees.

## Pages
- [Optimism Bridge](https://insert_url/): Ethereum to Optimism transfers, gas fee estimator, token matrix, route timing, security and FAQ.
- [Deposit fee estimator](https://insert_url/#fees): editable Ethereum gas price, deposit units, optional approval units, route fees and a gas budget margin.
- [Token matrix](https://insert_url/#routes): ETH, USDC, USDC.e and USDT by bridging mechanism.
- [Bridge application](https://insert_url/dashboard/): start an Optimism Bridge transfer.

## Network and routes
- Source: Ethereum mainnet, chain ID 1.
- Destination: OP Mainnet, chain ID 10.
- ETH pays gas on both networks.
- Standard Bridge deposits usually take 1-3 minutes.
- Canonical withdrawals require initiation, proof, a seven-day challenge period after proof, and finalization.
- Liquidity routes use provider-funded payouts; fees, tokens and timing depend on the route.
- Ethereum USDC through the Standard Bridge arrives as USDC.e. Circle CCTP moves native USDC through burning and minting.

## Fee calculation
Gas cost in ETH = gas units multiplied by gas price in gwei divided by 1,000,000,000. Add optional approval gas and route fees. The optional margin applies to gas costs. The transfer principal is separate. All parameters are editable; use the transaction gas estimate from the wallet. Actual gas charges use gas consumed and the effective gas price.

## Transfer checks
Confirm the destination network, full recipient address, receiving token contract and approval spender. Keep ETH on Ethereum for the deposit and ETH on Optimism for later transactions.
